title: Marine paintings exhibited in Nice (Aivazovsky)
extra_mentions: 097.0054 (a different single picture, «un tableau d'Ayvosonsky» at the Abazas' house in Poltava)
doubts: Exhibition-level entry; no catalogue or press notice found for the Hôtel Chauvain show, pictures unidentified, so no image. Wikipedia dates his Nice trip 1872, Marie's visit is 1 March 1874. 018.0244 is a comparison, not a visit. Mention 017.0090 is tagged with people/mentioned/AIVAZOVSKY, 018.0244 with culture/history/AIVAZOWSKY (two artist pages exist, unmerged).

title: Mary Magdalene (Pitti)
doubts: 043.0164 = Pitti Penitent Magdalene (image added). 053.0378 (Doria, Rome) not confirmed as Titian: the Doria Pamphilj has a copy after Titian (Commons) and Caravaggio's Magdalene; no free image of it. Dating c.1531-35 varies by source.

title: Venus de' Medici
doubts: Image is an Alinari albumen photograph c.1875-1900 (Rijksmuseum, CC0). 043.0191 is tagged culture/art/VENUS_DE_MILO (wrong: the Medici Venus) and could be re-tagged; 043.0200 reason for her pride is not stated. VENUS_DE_MILO.md still carries an RSR note saying the Medici Venus has no entry; it now has one.

title: Samson Fountain (Peterhof)
doubts: Marie saw Kozlovsky's 1802 bronze (lost in WWII, replaced 1947), not the 1735 lead original nor today's copy. The only free pre-1941 photo found shows the central jet from above, statue hidden; no photo of the Kozlovsky statue itself. Marie says tiger, it is a lion. Footnote 064.0475.5 gives 1735, which is Rastrelli's original.

title: Gretchen (Gabriel von Max)
doubts: Specific painting still unidentified; candidates (Gretchen in der Walpurgisnacht 1873, Die Kindesmörderin 1877) come from a Wikipedia mirror and are not confirmed. No image. Existing process-style RSR notes at the foot of the entry were left in place.

title: Beatrice Cenci (portrait attributed to Guido Reni)
doubts: Portrait now attributed to Ginevra Cantofoli (c.1650) by Barberini Corsini per the Commons description; diary footnotes still say Reni. Sitter identification is traditional. 057.0214 and 059.0849 are self-comparisons; 059.0849 carries no glossary tags.

title: Le Mendiant
doubts: Canvas signed Damvillers 1880 (Copenhagen Glyptotek); biographies and footnote 091.0548 say 1881. Salon-1881 exhibition inferred from Marie placing it beside the Wolff portrait. 099.0228 «le mendiant» probable but untitled.

title: Petits paysages de nuit (Cazin)
extra_mentions: 097.0322 (first sight of Cazin, rue de Sèze, 31 Dec 1882)
doubts: No title identified; not a single work, so no image. Possibly the same canvas in 098.0189 and 103.0240.

title: Phèdre (Cabanel)
extra_mentions: 103.0058 (une Aurore de Bouguereau ou un tableau historique de Cabanel)
doubts: Phèdre = Cabanel, Salon 1880, Musée Fabre (gift of the artist). The Aurore is Bouguereau's (103.0058), not Cabanel's: the LAN note at 103.0046 and 103.0178 attributes both to Cabanel. 103.0046 is tagged culture/literature/COROT (a wrong category for Corot, outside this batch). Dimensions differ between the Musée Fabre file (194 x 286) and a dealer listing.

title: Peinture de Bouguereau « volant » Raphaël
doubts: The picture is unidentified: no title or subject in the diary and no clue in the preceding paragraphs. Entry says so plainly; no image.
